@bootstraponline @mcactive Thanks for sharing this! I've reached out to the core team to have them take a look. Thanks!

Hi @bootstraponline - thanks for the report :smile:

As `fastlane_require` is written right now, it doesn't appear to me to be a drop-in replacement for Ruby's `require`. Meaning, you shouldn't use `fastlane_require` everywhere you'd normally use `require`.

`fastlane_require` tries to ensure that a Gem matching the provided name is installed before attempting to later require it. This doesn't make sense for Ruby system-provided libraries like `posix/spawn`. `fastlane_require` seems to be related to the _fastlane_ plugin system. @KrauseFx Do you have any more context about it? Is it intended for user use at all?

@bootstraponline can you share how/where you got the idea to use `fastlane_require` in this way?

Thanks! 👍

> This doesn't make sense for Ruby system-provided libraries like posix/spawn

[posix-spawn](https://github.com/rtomayko/posix-spawn) is not a system library.

> @bootstraponline can you share how/where you got the idea to use fastlane_require in this way?

Fastlane is telling people to break their code...

> fastlane
> [17:02:20]: You require a gem, please call `fastlane_require 'posix/spawn'` before to ensure the gem is installed

This is a bug in `fastlane_require` related to gem names. Fastlane is not able to determine that `posix/spawn` is a valid require for the `posix-spawn` gem. This Fastfile reproduces the problem:

``` ruby
fastlane_version "1.108.0"
default_platform :android
platform :android do
  desc "Runs all the requires"
  lane :test do
    # require 'posix/spawn'
    fastlane_require 'posix/spawn'
  end
end
```
Thanks for the clarifications - my initial tests to try to understand were insufficient! 👍

If you look at [posix-spawn.rb](https://github.com/rtomayko/posix-spawn/blob/master/lib/posix-spawn.rb) it just runs `require "posix/spawn"` so there are two valid ways to require the gem.

My work around for now is to do `fastlane_require 'posix-spawn'` instead of `fastlane_require 'posix/spawn'`. Both work with regular require. The bug is that both should also work with fastlane_require.
